source: NCBI PubMed E-utilities reference runs (stage 1, interim, not committed); Atlas works from data/processed/normalized/works.parquet, published subset from site/data/index.json
definition: Coverage is the share of PubMed reference records that also appear among the published Atlas works, joined by PMID and then by DOI. Each reference set is a PubMed search for plastics papers with a California affiliation. Coverage is not a completeness rate for the field: the reference sets are search results, not samples of a defined population; the California filter (California[ad]) is approximate; and MeSH indexing lags and varies by record, so recent years look worse. A reference record that is not among the published works is a miss, and a miss is not automatically a false negative of the Atlas. False negatives are estimated only from a fixed-seed sample of misses that is triaged by hand into failure-taxonomy classes.

r1.description: PubMed MeSH-indexed microplastics records, California affiliation (narrow set)

r2.description: PubMed title and abstract plastics terms, California affiliation (broad set)
r2.query_translation: ("microplastic"[Title/Abstract] OR "nanoplastic"[Title/Abstract] OR "micro-plastic"[Title/Abstract] OR "nano-plastic"[Title/Abstract] OR "micro-sized plastic"[Title/Abstract] OR "microsized plastics"[Title/Abstract] OR "plastic pollution"[Title/Abstract] OR "plastic debris"[Title/Abstract] OR "plastic litter"[Title/Abstract] OR "marine debris"[Title/Abstract] OR "marine litter"[Title/Abstract] OR "plastic particles"[Title/Abstract] OR "plastic fragments"[Title/Abstract] OR "plastic ingestion"[Title/Abstract] OR "resin pellet"[Title/Abstract] OR "plastic pellet"[Title/Abstract] OR "macroplastic"[Title/Abstract] OR "mesoplastic"[Title/Abstract] OR "plastics pollution"[Title/Abstract] OR "plastic pollutants"[Title/Abstract] OR "plastic trash"[Title/Abstract] OR "anthropogenic litter"[Title/Abstract] OR "anthropogenic debris"[Title/Abstract] OR "anthropogenic microparticles"[Title/Abstract] OR "anthropogenic microparticle"[Title/Abstract] OR "ingested plastic"[Title/Abstract] OR "ingested plastics"[Title/Abstract] OR "plastic contamination"[Title/Abstract] OR "plastic recycling"[Title/Abstract] OR "plastics recycling"[Title/Abstract] OR "recycled plastic"[Title/Abstract] OR "recycled plastics"[Title/Abstract] OR "single-use plastics"[Title/Abstract] OR "biodegradable plastic"[Title/Abstract] OR "biodegradable plastics"[Title/Abstract]) AND "California"[Affiliation] AND 1950/01/01:2026/11/21[Date - Publication]

miss_triage.sample_rule: first min(50, misses) misses by sha256(seed:pmid)
